summary: Completed Phase 2 E2E testing for Sukhmal Dry Fruits Korner e-commerce app. Backend APIs 100% passing (23/23 tests). Frontend UI loads correctly but CRITICAL cart persistence bug found blocking purchase flow. Admin security check passed. Content pages functional.

critical_bugs.issue: Cart items are added to localStorage on PDP but disappear when navigating to /cart page. localStorage shows item after Add to Cart (verified), but cart page shows empty state. Cart persistence is broken.
critical_bugs.impact: BLOCKS entire purchase flow - users cannot checkout
critical_bugs.reproduction: 1. Go to /product/california-almonds-premium 2. Click Add to Cart 3. Navigate to /cart 4. Cart shows empty despite localStorage containing the item
critical_bugs.evidence: localStorage after add: {items:[{key:p_almonds_premium250gproduct,...}]} but cart page shows: {items:[]}
critical_bugs.root_cause_hypothesis: CartContext may be clearing cart on mount or there's a race condition in useEffect initialization. The cart is saved to localStorage but not properly loaded when Cart page mounts.

ui_bugs.issue: Cart badge (data-testid='cart-badge') not found in header - users cannot see cart item count

priority_1_critical: FIX CART PERSISTENCE BUG: Cart items are added to localStorage but disappear when navigating to /cart page. Check CartContext initialization logic - the useEffect that loads from localStorage may not be firing correctly or cart is being cleared on mount. This blocks the entire purchase flow.
ADD CART BADGE: Implement cart badge in header with data-testid='cart-badge' to show item count
priority_2_testing_needed: After cart bug is fixed, re-test full purchase flow: PDP → Add to Cart → Cart → Apply Coupon → Checkout → Place Order → Order Success
Test Build Hamper wizard end-to-end (all 6 steps)
Test Gift Hamper detail page and Add Hamper to Cart

Consider adding loading states for Add to Cart button to provide user feedback

notes.backend_status: All backend APIs working perfectly. Phase 1 POC payment core (idempotent orders, webhook signature validation, atomic stock decrement) fully functional.
notes.frontend_status: UI renders correctly, navigation works, pages load. Critical cart persistence bug blocks purchase flow.
notes.security_status: Admin silent redirect working correctly - non-admin users cannot access /admin and are redirected to /login without any admin-related text exposure.
